# Plan

Single source of truth for targets.

## Goal

Lose about 5 kg (68 to 63 kg), no date; get stronger.

## Now

## Diet

- 1,750 kcal a day, 120 g protein.
- Sunday family lunch stays: lighter dinner that day.
- No food tracking: no message means the plan was followed.

## Training

3 days a week, about 50 minutes, on days off from shifts.

| Session | Main lifts |
|---|---|
| Full body A | squat 3x6-8, dumbbell bench press 3x8-10, seated row 3x10-12 |
| Full body B | deadlift 3x5, overhead press 3x8-10, lat pulldown 3x10-12 |
| Full body C | leg press 3x10-12, incline dumbbell press 3x8-10, hip thrust 3x8-10 |

Add weight when every set reaches the top of the range.

## Daily targets

- 7,000 steps.
- 7 hours of sleep, when shifts allow.

## Adjustment rules

- Weekly average down 0.25 to 0.6 kg: keep.
- Flat for 2 weeks: minus 150 kcal.
- Down more than 0.8 kg a week: plus 150 kcal.
